content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto is a straightforward process that empowers creators by eliminating reliance on high-fee platforms. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a hefty 10% cut from every sale, using NOWPayments allows you to process transactions at only 0.5%. This significant difference in fees means that with 100 sales of a $97 product each month, you would retain an additional $921. This model supports creators in regions where conventional online payment systems are unavailable, allowing them to build sustainable income streams.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling Notion templates using COREMERCH is rooted in a combination of free and open-source tools. By deploying your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you can host your templates without incurring costs. Using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate backend processes, including order fulfillment. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which verifies transactions on-chain at a minimal fee, providing you with immediate confirmation and delivery of digital products. This infrastructure is designed for efficiency and ownership.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically built for digital creators who face barriers with conventional payment systems. If you are in Nigeria, Kenya, or any country where platforms like PayPal are not an option, this architecture provides the autonomy you need. It allows you to sell products like templates, ebooks, and courses without the constraints of middlemen taking a large chunk of your earnings. By choosing to use this system, you are opting for financial sovereignty and control over your sales process.
Save thousands in fees by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this sovereign digital commerce stack work in harmony to create a seamless experience for both the creator and the customer. The use of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting ensures your site is always available. Automations via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers allow for quick order processing and product delivery. NOWPayments provides a reliable method for accepting over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that you can cater to a global audience while minimizing transaction fees. Together, these elements form a robust and resilient infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates for crypto, first, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which offers complete documentation for deploying your stack. Next, set up your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your templates. Configure your backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for order processing. Then, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, ensure your delivery methods are automated to provide instant access to your customers upon purchase. You can find additional resources and products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

By using tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing crypto, you can set up a fully operational store. Own your entire digital storefront without dependence on third-party services.

Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
